name: insta-pending-snapshot-blocks-inline-fix
description: After an inline fabro_snapshot/assert_snapshot test fails once, insta writes a pending snapshot; fixing the inline literal is not enough while a stale pending exists — the test keeps failing against the OLD text. Fix: cargo insta reject --snapshot '<file>:<line>', then touch the test file to force a rebuild (nextest may re-run a stale binary otherwise), then re-run.

When a cargo nextest failure contradicts the current source (shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR), the run may execute a stale test binary and re-emit the old failure text. Touch BOTH the changed src file and the test file (or cargo clean -p the crate) and re-run before re-diagnosing; a plain nextest re-run is not evidence of a rebuild.
resolution: Touch both changed src and test files (or cargo clean -p the crate) and re-run before re-diagnosing; treat a plain nextest re-run as unreliable evidence of a rebuild.
